args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the ExportButton component so that the busy state is cleared even if the exportReport promise rejects, allowing the button to be enabled again after a failed export. Currently, the busy state is set to false only on successful completion, which leaves the button disabled after an error. This fix calls setBusy(false) in both success and failure cases using a finally block or equivalent.
